note: Santander International (Santander Financial Services plc, Isle of Man Branch) issues the island's only cards found with published terms: its Key Facts Document for the Silver, Gold Select and Black World Elite Charge Cards (effective from 25 January 2026), read on 2026-11-03 in Common Crawl's capture of 13 October 2026 (CC-MAIN-2026-43), the live site answering with an Incapsula check. Each is a charge card in sterling, euros or dollars (written in sterling, the island's currency), its whole balance taken each month from the holder's Gold Account, so no interest is charged (written as in full). The annual main card fee: Silver nothing (an introductory offer the bank may end, up to 100 a year from an anniversary; written as none, as it stands); Gold Select 300 (waived for Santander Select customers, a standing the game doesn't check, so charged in full); Black World Elite 650 (800 charged and 150 refunded to the Gold Account on the next statement, the table's net 650 written). Holding a card needs a Gold Account and 25,000 on deposit or a salary paid in, which the game doesn't check. The card's foreign exchange and cash fees sit in AF Payments Ltd's fees table, a PDF behind a script button that the crawl doesn't hold, so they aren't written and the game says it doesn't know them. The Isle of Man Bank and NatWest International list no credit card for the island (their sitemaps read 2026-11-03).

sources.title: Santander International, Key Facts Document: Silver, Gold Select and Black World Elite Charge Cards (effective from 25 January 2026), read in Common Crawl's capture of 13 October 2026 (CC-MAIN-2026-43)
sources.said: Effective from 25 January 2026 ... You have a choice of three Charge Cards, all available in Sterling, Euro or US dollars: Silver Charge Card Gold Select Charge Card Black World Elite Charge Card ... You must hold a Gold Account with us in the same currency as the Charge Card You must either: hold a minimum of £/€/$ 25,000 on deposit with us; or mandate your salary to us into the associated Gold Account ... Charge Card Annual main card fee Annual supplemental or associate card fee Silver Charge Card £/€/$ 0* £/€/$ 50 Gold Select Charge Card £/€/$300** £/€/$300 Black World Elite Charge Card £/€/$ 650*** £/€/$ 400 * This is an introductory offer and if it ends, you will start to be charged an annual membership fee of up to £/€/$100 at the first or subsequent anniversary dates. ** The annual main card fee will be waived for eligible Santander Select customers (Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man residents only). *** The standard main card fee is £/€/$ 800 and you will see this fee amount on your card statement in the month it is charged each year. You will then see a refund of £/€/$ 150 on the next statement for the Gold Account that the Charge Card is linked to. Interest rate No interest is charged as your outstanding card balance must always be paid off in full each month ... You must pay the full outstanding card balance each month and we will automatically debit the monthly payment from your Gold Account on the due date on your behalf.
